featured_reviews.name: SAHIL RATNAPARKHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited FunTime Carnival and overall it was a really great experience. It’s an all-year-round carnival with a good variety of rides, each priced differently — ₹100, ₹200, or ₹300 per person.
The entry ticket is ₹100 per head, and that ticket can be used for any ride of the same cost, which is a nice and flexible system.
We had a great time — bumper cars, kids’ play area, and the zip-line adventure zone were definite highlights. We visited in the second week after opening, so some rides were still being installed and work was ongoing, which is understandable.

One major downside was the Arcade zone inside. It consists of machine games and prize-winning games. Entry is ₹200 per person, and you get three attempts at each of the five games. However, you only get a prize if you win all five games, which is practically impossible since a few games are quite tricky.
The prize is just a small (~30 cm) stuffed toy, which is not worth the price. Bigger toys are displayed but cannot be won. This wasn’t clearly explained beforehand — otherwise, we wouldn’t have played at all. I’d strongly suggest skipping the Arcade section.
Another drawback was the food, which felt way too expensive for what was offered.

Despite these two points, we had a great time overall and would definitely visit again, mainly for the rides and overall carnival vibe.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Everyone is warm, kind, and welcoming, and the whole space feels like a genuinely great community to be part of.

Also loved their Harry Potter event — it was incredibly immersive and thoughtfully done. You could really see the effort put into creating the experience. Definitely a place worth visiting if you enjoy board games and community-driven events.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Kinkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Timezone at Phoenix Palladium is hands-down one of the best spots in Mumbai for a fun day out. Tucked away on the Third Floor of the East Wing, it is incredibly easy to find and offers a massive variety of games that keep both kids and adults thoroughly entertained.The arcade selection here is top-notch. They have the latest immersive VR games like Virtual Rabbids and Dark Mars VR, which are absolutely thrilling. Beyond video games, the social play options are fantastic. We had an incredible time hitting the bowling lanes and driving the bumper cars, making it the perfect spot to hang out with a group of friends or family. It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. It gets busy on weekends, but the weekday deals make it completely worth a mid-week visit. Highly recommended!
